pages.text: The diagrams look down from the wagon’s front left. Cyan outlines mark new parts; dashed lines indicate hidden wheels on the far side.$(br2)Fit the jack, box, driver’s seat, shafts, front wheels and rear wheels in order. Each step’s right-hand page shows the result.

Leave room around the jack. Fit required parts while it is $(bold)extended$(reset).$(br2)Placing a part once creates its complete multiblock component. Incorrect mounting positions or blocked space prevent installation.
pages.title: Before Building

pages.text: Place the jack normally to start extended. Sneak-place it to start folded; extend it before building. Wait for the animation to finish.
pages.title: Step 1: The Jack

pages.text: The extended jack supports the deck.
Use the wagon box on the jack’s $(bold)upper platform$(reset). The deck, sideboards, tailgate, footboard and steps are placed together. Do not build it block by block.
pages.title: Step 2: The Box

pages.text: Place the whole box at once.
Fit a driver’s seat at the front centre, above the footboard. Choose a wooden or upholstered seat. A cargo stool cannot replace the required driver’s seat.
pages.title: Step 3: The Seat

pages.text: Fit the seat above the front footboard.
Fit shafts at the $(bold)front centre$(reset) of the box, below the footboard. Single shafts need one animal; double shafts need two. Hitch animals after assembly creates the wagon entity.
pages.title: Step 4: The Shafts

pages.text: The shafts project from the front.
Fit two $(bold)small wheels$(reset), one at each end of the front axle. Walk around to fit the far wheel. Large wheels do not belong on the front axle.
pages.title: Step 5: Front Wheels

pages.text: One small wheel at each front axle end.
Fit two $(bold)large wheels$(reset), one at each end of the rear axle. Check that all four wheels are present. Cabinets, cargo covers and canopies are optional.
pages.title: Step 6: Rear Wheels

pages.text: One large wheel at each rear axle end.

Use the jack. If required parts are complete and correctly fitted, it folds and the wagon becomes an entity immediately. Missing parts produce a message and prevent folding.$(br2)Clicks during the animation are ignored. An empty jack can still extend and fold normally.
